Cross-entropy elbow plot for choosing K

Source: R/pop_structure.R
plot_snmf_cross_entropy.Rd

Cross-entropy against K, so the elbow (or the absence of one) is visible. The line follows stat, and show_range = TRUE adds the replicate min-max band – a wide band means the replicates disagreed and that K is not reproducible.

Usage

plot_snmf_cross_entropy(
  x,
  K = NULL,
  stat = c("min", "mean"),
  show_range = TRUE,
  best_k = NULL,
  point_size = 2.4,
  line_width = 0.6
)

Arguments

x

An run_snmf() result, or a table from snmf_cross_entropy().

K

Candidate K values (defaults to the fitted range).

stat

Which summary the line follows: "min" (default – the replicate that snmf_q() plots) or "mean".

show_range

Draw the replicate min-max band (default TRUE).

best_k

K to mark in red; NULL (default) marks the K minimising stat, NA marks none.

point_size, line_width

Point and line sizes.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fit <- run_snmf(geno, K = 1:10, rep = 10)
snmf_cross_entropy(fit)          # the numbers
plot_snmf_cross_entropy(fit)     # the elbow
} # }
